## Supplemental enforcement directions

This supplemental order concerns the format of the enforcement bundle. The substantive obligation and the amount payable remain unchanged. No personal particulars or party names are reproduced in this administrative copy, which may be circulated to the document-production team.

The revised bundle must distinguish the order being enforced from supporting correspondence. A document reference is an exhibit locator and does not identify a person, a bank account or a separate proceeding. The following references must remain in the index:

- Exhibit EXH-784221: a receipt for packing materials.
- Exhibit DOC-629418: an unsigned delivery checklist.
- Annex SUP-372865: a calculation of the outstanding copying charge.

The total charge is GBP 84.50. It includes GBP 70 for copying and GBP 14.50 for postage. The figures are amounts, not telephone or tax numbers. No additional charge may be added for preparing the corrected index.

The revised bundle is due on 12 December 2026. Section 9.3 governs the sequence of the documents, while article 24 concerns the form of certification. Neither reference is a claim or case number.

The production team must leave the blank contact fields empty. A signature image, personal identifier or example account number must not be inserted merely to demonstrate the layout. All earlier directions continue to apply except where expressly varied by this order.
